user.title: Find an Echo Button
user.description: Hold the button until its light turns orange, then select Submit to scan for Classic Bluetooth buttons. Previously paired buttons can also be selected.

select.title: Select an Echo Button
select.description: Select the button you want to add to Home Assistant.

error.cannot_scan: Could not scan the host Bluetooth adapter. Check the logs and try again.
error.no_buttons: No Echo Buttons were found. Hold a button until its light turns orange and try again.
error.cannot_pair: Could not pair this button. Put it in orange pairing mode and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Echo Button is already configured.
